CustomField.description: The type of the failure this entry records: a fully qualified Apex exception class name (e.g., System.DmlException), or for entries logged from a Lightning web component, the JavaScript error name or the Apex type relayed from a failed server call.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The error type that was caught, if applicable: an Apex exception class or, for component entries, the JavaScript error name.
CustomField.label: Exception Type
